sql: SELECT b.period_start, b.period_end, b.days, CAST(b.kwh AS DOUBLE) AS kwh, count(CAST(w.TMAX AS DOUBLE) + CAST(w.TMIN AS DOUBLE)) AS weather_days, coalesce(round(sum(greatest((CAST(w.TMAX AS DOUBLE) + CAST(w.TMIN AS DOUBLE)) / 2 - 65, 0)), 1), 0) AS cdd, coalesce(round(sum(greatest(65 - (CAST(w.TMAX AS DOUBLE) + CAST(w.TMIN AS DOUBLE)) / 2, 0)), 1), 0) AS hdd FROM (VALUES (DATE '2025-12-10', DATE '2026-01-12', 33, 1450), (DATE '2026-01-12', DATE '2026-02-10', 29, 1520)) AS b(period_start, period_end, days, kwh) LEFT JOIN noaa_ncei.cmh_daily_from_2024 w ON to_date(w.DATE) >= b.period_start AND to_date(w.DATE) < b.period_end GROUP BY b.period_start, b.period_end, b.days, b.kwh ORDER BY b.period_start
